items.text: Izwi likaJehova lafika kimi, lathi:
Ndodana yomuntu, iJerusalema malazi izinengiso zalo,
uthi: Isho kanje iNkosi uJehova kulo iJerusalema; Ukuzalwa kwakho nozalo lwakho kuvela ezweni laseKhanani; uyihlo wayengumAmori, unyoko engumHeti.
Ngokuqondene nokuzalwa kwakho, ngosuku owazalwa ngalo, inkaba yakho ayizange inqunywe, futhi awugezwanga ngamanzi ukuba wondle; ubungenawo nhlobo usawoti futhi ungabandakanyeki nhlobo.
Alikho iso elikuyekile ukwenza noma iyiphi yalezi zinto kuwe ukuba libe nesihe kuwe; kodwa waphonswa ngaphandle endle, ngenxa yokunengeka kobuntu bakho, ngosuku owazalwa ngalo.
Lapho ngidlula kuwe, ngakubona ungcolile ngegazi lakho, ngathi kuwe usegazini lakho: Phila! yebo, ngathi kuwe usegazini lakho: Phila!
Ngakwenza wande njengembewu yasendle, wanda, wakhula, wafika emihlobeni emihle kakhulu;

Lapho ngidlula kuwe, ngakubona, bheka, isikhathi sakho kwakuyisikhathi sothando; ngendlala ingubo yami phezu kwakho, ngembesa ubunqunu bakho; yebo, ngafunga kuwe, ngenza isivumelwano nawe, isho iNkosi uJehova, waba ngowami.
Ngakugeza ngamanzi; yebo, ngigezisile igazi lakho kuwe, ngakugcoba ngamafutha.
Ngakugqokisa izinto ezilukiweyo, ngakugqokisa izicathulo zezikhumba zamatahasi, ngakubhincisa ilineni elicolekileyo, ngakumboza ngosilika.
Ngakuhlobisa ngezivunulo, ngakufaka amasongo ezandleni neketanga entanyeni yakho.
Ngafaka itshe ebunzini lakho namacici ezindlebeni zakho nomqhele omuhle ekhanda lakho.
Wawuhlotshiswe ngegolide nangesiliva; izingubo zakho zazingezelineni elicolekileyo, nosilika, nezelukiweyo; wadla impuphu ecolekileyo nezinyosi namafutha, wawumuhle kakhulu, waphumelela embusweni.
Udumo lwakho lwaphumela ezizweni ngenxa yobuhle bakho, ngokuba bapheleliswa ngobuhle bami engabubeka phezu kwakho, isho iNkosi uJehova.
Kodwa wethemba ebuhleni bakho, wafeba ngenxa yebizo lakho, wathululela ubufebe bakho phezu kwabo bonke abadlulayo; bekungeyakhe.
Wathatha ezinye zezingubo zakho, wahlobisa izindawo zakho eziphakemeyo ngemibala eminingi, wafeba kuzo; izinto ezinjalo aziyikufika, futhi aziyikuba njalo.
Wathatha nezinto zakho ezinhle egolideni lami nasesilivani lami engakunika lona, wazenzela izithombe zabantu, wafeba nazo.
Wathatha izingubo zakho ezilukiweyo, wazimboza; wabeka amafutha ami nempepho yami phambi kwazo.
Ukudla kwami engakunika khona, impuphu ecolekileyo, namafutha, nezinyosi, engakondla ngakho, wakunika khona, kube yiphunga elimnandi; kwaba njalo, isho iNkosi uJehova.
Futhi wathatha amadodana akho namadodakazi akho owangizalela wona, wawanikela ukuba adliwe. Kuyinto encane yini ubufebe bakho,
Ukuthi ubulele abantwana bami, wabanikela ukuba badabule bona ngokwabo emlilweni?
Kuzo zonke izinengiso zakho nobufebe bakho awukhumbulanga izinsuku zobusha bakho, lapho wawunqunu, uyinyumba, ungcoliswe ngegazi lakho.
Futhi lokhu kwenzeka ngemva kwabo bonke ububi bakho, maye, maye kini, isho iNkosi uJehova!
ukuthi wazakhela indawo enhle kakhulu, wazenzela indawo ephakemeyo ezitaladini zonke.
Wakha indawo ephakemeyo kuzo zonke izinhloko zemigwaqo, wenza ubuhle bakho baba yisinengiso, wavulela bonke abadlulayo izinyawo zakho, wandisa ubufebe bakho.
Wafeba nabaseGibithe, abakhelwane bakho, abakhulu ngenyama; ngandisa ubufebe bakho ukuze ungicunule.
Bheka, yingakho ngelulela isandla sami phezu kwakho, nganciphisa ukudla okudlayo, ngakunikela entandweni yabakuzondayo, amadodakazi amaFilisti anamahloni ngendlela yakho eyihlazo.
Wafeba nama-Asiriya, ngokuba ungasuthi; yebo, wafeba nabo, nokho awuneliswanga.
Futhi wandisa ubufebe bakho ezweni laseKhanani kuze kube seKaledi; nokho anigculisekanga ngakho.
Yeka ukuthi inhliziyo yakho ibuthakathaka kangakanani, isho iNkosi uJehova, ngokuba wenza zonke lezi zinto, umsebenzi wesifebe esibusayo;
Ngokwakha udumo lwakho emakhanda azo zonke izindlela, wenze ukuphakama kwakho kuzo zonke izitaladi; futhi awuzange ube njengesifebe ngokudelela inkokhelo;
Kodwa njengowesifazana ophingayo, othatha izihambi esikhundleni sendoda yakhe!
Zonke izifebe zinika izipho, kodwa wena upha zonke izithandwa zakho izipho zakho, uziqatshe, ukuze zize kuwe zivela nhlangothi zonke ngenxa yobufebe bakho.
Futhi okuphambene nalokho kukini kwabanye besifazane ebufebeni benu, kuyilapho kungekho muntu onilandela ukuze aphinge;
Ngakho, sifebe, yizwa izwi likaJehova.

Isho kanje iNkosi uJehova, ithi: Ngenxa yokuthi ukungcola kwakho kuthululiwe, nobunqunu bakho sembulwe ngokuphinga kwakho nezithandwa zakho nangabo bonke onkulunkulu abangcolileyo bezinengiso zakho nangegazi labantwana bakho obanike lona;

Ngakho-ke bheka, ngiyakubutha zonke izithandwa zakho, owajabula ngazo, nabo bonke owabathanda, kanye nabo bonke obazondayo; Futhi ngiyobabutha nxazonke kuwe futhi ngembule ubunqunu bakho kubo, ukuze babone lonke ihlazo lakho.
Ngiyakunahlulela njengabesifazane abachitha umshado nabachitha igazi; ngiyakuninika igazi lokufutheka nokushisekela.

Futhi ngiyokunikela esandleni sabo, futhi bayodiliza indawo yakho eyisiduli, badilize izindawo zakho eziphakemeyo; futhi bayokuhlubula izingubo zakho bakuthathele amagugu akho amahle bakushiye unqunu futhi obala.
Futhi bayokuphakamisela isixuku futhi bakukhande ngamatshe futhi bakugwaze ngezinkemba zabo.
Bayoshisa izindlu zakho ngomlilo, bakwenzele izijeziso phambi kwamehlo abesifazane abaningi; futhi ngiyokwenza ukuba uyeke ubufebe, futhi ungase ungabe usanikeza inkokhelo.
Khona ngizakwehlisela ulaka lwami kuwe, lokutshiseka kwami kusuke kuwe, ngithule ngingabe ngisathukuthela.

Ngokuba awukhumbulanga izinsuku zobusha bakho, kepha wangikhathaza kukho konke lokho; bheka, ngiyakubeka indlela yakho phezu kwekhanda lakho, isho iNkosi uJehova; futhi akumelwe wenze lesi senzo esiyihlazo ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinengiso zakho.
Bheka, bonke abasebenzisa izaga mabasebenzise lesi saga ngawe, bathi: ‘Njengonina, injalo indodakazi yakhe.
Wena uyindodakazi kanyoko, ozonda umyeni wakhe nabantwana bakhe; wena ungudade wabodadewenu ababezonda abayeni babo nabantwana babo; unyoko wayengumHeti, uyihlo engumAmori.
Udadewenu omkhulu uyiSamariya namadodakazi alo ahlala ngakwesobunxele sakho; udadewenu omncane ohlala ngakwesokunene sakho yiSodoma namadodakazi ayo.
Kodwa awuhambanga ngezindlela zabo, awenzanga njengezinengiso zabo, kepha kwaba sengathi kuyinto encane kakhulu, wonakala kunabo ezindleleni zakho zonke.
Kuphila kwami, isho iNkosi uJehova, iSodoma udadewenu akenzanga, lona namadodakazi alo, njengalokho wenzile, wena namadodakazi akho.
Bheka, lobu yibubi bukadadewenu iSodoma;
Futhi babezidla futhi benza izinengiso phambi kwami; ngakho ngazisusa ngokubona kwami.
NeSamariya alenzanga ingxenye yezono zakho; kepha wena wandisa izinengiso zakho kunabo, walungisisa odadewenu kuzo zonke izinengiso zakho ozenzileyo.
Nawe owahlulela odadewenu, thwala ihlazo lakho ngezono zakho ozenze okubi kakhulu kunabo; bahle kunawe; osisi.
Lapho ngibuyisa ukuthunjwa kwabo, ukuthunjwa kweSodoma lamadodakazi ayo, lokuthunjwa kweSamariya lamadodakazi ayo, ngizabuyisela ukuthunjwa kwabathunjwa bakho phakathi kwabo.
Ukuze uthwale ihlazo lakho, ube lenhloni kukho konke okwenzileyo, ngoba uyinduduzo kibo.
Lapho odadewenu, iSodoma namadodakazi alo, sebebuyela ezweni lakubo lakuqala, neSamariya namadodakazi alo ebuyela ezweni lakubo lakuqala, wena namadodakazi akho niyobuyela ezweni lakini.
Ngokuba iSodoma udadewenu ayiphathwanga emlonyeni wakho ngosuku lokuzidla kwakho,
Bungakabonakali ububi bakho, njengasesikhathini sokuhlanjalazwa kwakho amadodakazi ase-Aramu nabo bonke abayihaqayo, amadodakazi amaFilisti, ayekudelela nxazonke.
Uthwale ihlazo lakho nezinengiso zakho,” usho uJehova.
Ngokuba isho kanje iNkosi uJehova, ithi: Ngiyakwenza kuwe njengalokho okwenzileyo, odelele isifungo ngokwephula isivumelwano.
Kepha mina ngiyakukhumbula isivumelwano sami nawe ezinsukwini zobusha bakho, ngikumisele isivumelwano esiphakade.
Khona-ke uyozikhumbula izindlela zakho futhi ube namahloni, uma wamukela odadewenu, abadala bakho nabancane bakho; ngizakunika bona babe ngamadodakazi, kodwa kungeyisikho ngesivumelwano sakho.
Ngizamisa isivumelwano sami lani; nizokwazi ukuthi nginguJehova.
Ukuze ucabange, ume unamahloni, ungabe usavula umlomo wakho ngenxa yehlazo lakho, uma ngibuyisana nawe ngakho konke okwenzileyo, isho iNkosi uJehova.
